name: delivery-meeple-no-choice-v1
description: ⭐ DECOMPOSITION ARM 1 OF 3 (14/09/2026): THE DELIVERY MEEPLE ALONE, on the reference-v18 game. Its CONTROL is overlays/pre-delivery-meeple-v1.overlay.json and it differs from it in exactly the four meeple leaves, set here at the values Dean ruled: rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1 (a random meeple on every tile's 3 VP space), meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1 and meepleSpendDistinctColours false (M1 to M8). The two new island rules are pinned OFF by name: rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice false (fill order, so the meeple goes to whoever arrives second) and rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 0. ⛔ PASSENGERS, NAMED: rules.turn.startingMeeplesPerColour 0 and meepleAsCard false ride in from the base and are what keep this the EARNED island meeple rather than the ambient economy a table rejected on 09/09/2026; every other leaf is the shipped reference-v18 game (the two-board Notice Board visit, one-card plain-action balloons, the Village Store, apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild'), which is NOT the pre-12/09 base overlays/delivery-meeple-v1.overlay.json replays. Its sibling arms are overlays/delivery-meeple-choice-v1.overlay.json and overlays/closing-draw-only-v1.overlay.json. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors), paired on identical reference-v18 seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the closing draw were removed with them.
